Container.Name: local-dl
Container.Overview: HTTP service that downloads files from Put.io directly to your Plex/Unraid media directories. Works alongside putio-go-server: polls for new download jobs every 5 minutes, runs up to 3 concurrent downloads, and automatically organises TV shows into ShowName/Season_XX/ folders with standardised filenames. Also maintains a local SQLite catalog of all media files and syncs it to putio-go-server for Discord library queries.
Container.Description: Downloads files from Put.io to your Plex media directories with automatic TV show organisation.

Config.Name: TV Shows Path
Config.Description: Destination on Unraid for TV show files.

Config.Name: Movies Path
Config.Description: Destination on Unraid for movie files.

Config.Name: App Data (catalog database)
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite catalog database. Use an appdata path so the catalog survives container updates.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the local-dl HTTP API. Used internally by putio-go-server.

Config.Name: CATALOG_DB
Config.Description: [Do not change] Path to the SQLite catalog database inside the container.

Config.Name: REMOTE_SERVER
Config.Description: URL of your putio-go-server instance. Change this if you are self-hosting.
